# AMY Team Studio

> AMY Team Studio is a software development studio building high-quality websites, digital products, and scalable software solutions.

## Main Pages

- [Home](http://localhost:3000/en): Overview of AMY Team Studio and its services.
- [Services](http://localhost:3000/en/services): Software development and digital product services.
- [Work](http://localhost:3000/en/work): Selected projects and examples of our work.
- [About](http://localhost:3000/en/about): Information about the studio and its approach.
- [Contact](http://localhost:3000/en/contact): Contact information and project inquiries.

## Arabic Pages

- [الرئيسية](http://localhost:3000/ar): نبذة عن الاستوديو وخدماته.
- [الخدمات](http://localhost:3000/ar/services): خدمات تطوير البرمجيات والمنتجات الرقمية.
- [أعمالنا](http://localhost:3000/ar/work): المشاريع والأعمال المختارة.
- [من نحن](http://localhost:3000/ar/about): معلومات عن الاستوديو ونهجه في العمل.
- [تواصل معنا](http://localhost:3000/ar/contact): التواصل لمناقشة المشاريع.

## Notes

- The studio focuses on website development, application development, and scalable software solutions.
- Project examples should be treated as portfolio demonstrations unless explicitly identified as completed client work.
